Evaluation & research

AI can accelerate synthesis and exploration, but findings still need traceable evidence. I separate model output, source material and participant research rather than treating them as interchangeable.

KREMOR AI · MODEL EVALUATION

Evaluate the output before designing around it.

I worked across forensic benchmarking, dataset annotation and qualitative evaluation of LLM and generative-image output alongside the product design work.

SETTLE · RESEARCH IN PROGRESS

Keep hypotheses separate from findings.

Settle uses official guidance to ground a dependency model while participant research is still ongoing. The page labels what is sourced, what is hypothesised…

AI product design

The model is only one part of the experience. The surrounding product still has to explain the next step, make responsibility visible and give people useful control.

GENERATIVE UX · KREMOR AI

Give people a first move.

Prompt scaffolding, conversational starting points, five operational roles, confirmation gates and audit history make an open-ended AI experience more controllable.

HUMAN REVIEW · CHALANT AI

Make judgement part of the task.

Learners manage AI agents, review generated work and remain responsible for what leaves the system instead of treating automation as automatic approval.

PROPOSAL · BIZINC

Connect conversation to a real task.

The AI-assisted search-to-booking concept explores conversational discovery, but stays clearly labelled as a proposal until live availability and booking impact are validated.
